chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar narrated to us from Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Azdi. He said: Isma'il ibn al-Fadl narrated to us from his father from Thabit ibn Dinar from Sa'id ibn Jubayr from Ibn 'Abbas. He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, God — Blessed and Exalted — revealed to me that He is going to appoint for me from my community a brother, an inheritor, a vicegerent (khalifa), and a deputy. So I said: 'O Lord! Who is it?' So He — Mighty and Majestic — revealed to me: 'O Muhammad! He is the Imam of your community and My Proof over it after you.' So I said: 'O Lord, who is it?' So He — Mighty and Majestic — revealed to me: 'O Muhammad! He is the one I love and who loves Me. He is the striver in My cause, the fighter of those who break My covenant, those who deviate in My judgment, and those who apostatize from My religion. He is truly My guardian — the husband of your daughter and the father of your descendants: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib.'

key_terms.القاسطين: Those who deviate — referring to the people of Siffin in Shia interpretation
key_terms.المارقين: Those who apostatize — referring to the Khawarij/Kharijites
key_terms.حجة: Proof/Authority — the divinely-appointed authority over the community
key_terms.ناكثي عهدي: Those who break My covenant — referring to the people of Jamal in Shia interpretation
key_terms.وارث: Inheritor — one who receives the Prophet's spiritual legacy
key_terms.وصي: Deputy/Executor — the designated trustee of the Prophet's mission
key_terms.ولي: Guardian/Friend — the one entrusted with divine authority and close to God

ai.seo_question: What revelation did God give the Prophet about 'Ali ibn Abi Talib as his brother and successor?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) relates a divine revelation in which God announces His appointment of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib as the Prophet's brother, inheritor, vicegerent, and deputy. God describes 'Ali as the one He loves and who loves Him, the Imam of the community, and His proof (hujja) after the Prophet. This hadith is a central text in the Shia tradition supporting the divine designation (nass) of Imam 'Ali for the leadership of the Islamic community. Narrated by Ibn 'Abbas, a leading Companion and Quranic authority, through Thabit ibn Dinar (Abu Hamza al-Thumali), this chain carries significant weight in Shia hadith literature.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abd al-Jabbar narrated to us from Abi Ahmad Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Azdi. He said: Isma`il b. al-Fadl narrated to us from his father from Thabit b. Dinar from Sa`id b. Jubayr from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Surely, Allah revealed to me that He is giving me a brother, inheritor, vicegerent (khalifa), and deputy from my Nation. So, I said: “O Lord! Who is he?” So, He revealed to me: “O Muhammad! He is the Imam of your Nation and My Proof over it after you.” So, I said: “O Lord, who is it?” So, He revealed to me: “O Muhammad! He is the one I love and the one who loves Me. He is the striver in My way, and the fighter of those who break My covenant, those who deviate from My judgment, and those who apostatize from My religion. He is truly My friend, the husband of your daughter, and the father of your descendants: `Ali b. Abi Talib.”
